as_told.title: Reverse engineering of a laser weapon from a downed Russian NHI spaceship

plain: Someone is said to have worked on taking apart and copying a laser weapon system recovered from a downed Russian craft. Michels describes it as "a downed Russian asset" while talking with Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who reports on UFOs. Corbell, citing sources he does not name here, goes further and calls the object a downed Russian "NHI spaceship," NHI meaning non-human intelligence. If true, it would mean Russia had a non-human craft and the US learned weapons technology from it.
